factual_methodology.summary: Independent pre-publication source cross-check: Cross-checked 1972 SALT I US/Soviet ICBM launcher inventory 1,054/1,618 and conditional SLBM maxima 710/950 from official U.S. defence and State Department documentation. Separates political arguments and outcomes.

research_depth.summary: More than 4,700 words per locale, distinct historical sections and competing views, no missing source references.

evidence_traceability.summary: Numbered citations all have corresponding entries, published primary writings checked for identity; critical numeric series verified against relevant official organizations.

counterfactual_review.summary: Observational and scenario/conditional numbers explicitly distinguished; disputed causal impact not asserted from calendar coincidences.

visual_evidence_readiness.summary: Two conceptually distinct and sourced comparable-unit figures replace chronology-only bar charts; matching numeric values EN/PT-BR with period and definition labels.

editorial_publication_readiness.summary: Removed r1 links to unapproved manuscripts, bibliographic inconsistencies and unsupported cross-person attributions corrected in rev2. Extended evidence-based treatment.

contrary_evidence: Statistical context does not measure influence of a philosophical movement or demonstrate the moral validity of political interventions.
Independent historical interpretations of international diplomacy vary across the documentary record.
limitations: Key documents and quantities checked against dated public primary or curated records; all off-site links have not been independently tested for uptime.
Source disagreements are identified; approval is for publication, not endorsement.
notes: Separate editorial recheck of revised manuscript and previously rejected evidence points, bound to exact source hashes and revision 2.
